import sys,random,itertools,json,base64,struct,plistlib,io
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
from common import validate
from planning import solve
from protocols import read_adb_response

def make_job(R,O,qnodes=4,onodes=4):
    random.seed(random.random())
    # random forests helper
    def forest(n):
        nodes=[]; parents={}
        for i in range(n):
            if i==0 or random.random()<0.25:
                p=None
            else:
                p=random.randrange(i)
                # depth <=31
                d=0;x=p
                while parents[x] is not None:
                    d+=1;x=parents[x]
                if d>=31: p=None
            parents[i]=p
            nodes.append({'id':f'n{i}','parent':None if p is None else f'n{p}','capacity':random.randrange(0,5)})
        return nodes
    rq=forest(qnodes); oq=forest(onodes)
    leases=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}]
    reqs=[]
    for i in range(R):
        reqs.append({'id':f'r{i}','at':0,'lease':'l','target':f'2001:db8:1:1200::{i+1}','service':'s','group':rq[i%qnodes]['id']})
    offers=[]
    for j in range(O):
        listed=random.sample([r['id'] for r in reqs],random.randrange(0,R+1))
        offers.append({'id':f'o{j}','time':random.randrange(0,100),'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':random.randrange(0,5),'cost':random.randrange(0,20),'group':oq[j%onodes]['id'],'requests':listed})
    job={'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':leases,'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':reqs,'offers':offers,'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':oq}
    return job

def qpaths(nodes):
    d={n['id']:n for n in nodes}; paths={}
    for nid in d:
        p=[];x=nid
        while x is not None:
            p.append(x);x=d[x]['parent']
        paths[nid]=p
    return d,paths

def brute(job,active):
    ctx=validate(job)
    reqs=ctx['requests']; offers=ctx['offers']; leases=ctx['leases']
    rq,rpaths=ctx['request_quotas'],ctx['request_paths']; oq,opaths=ctx['offer_quotas'],ctx['offer_paths']
    ids=[r for r in sorted(reqs) if active.get(r)]
    allowed={}
    for rid in ids:
        req=reqs[rid];lst=[]
        for oid,o in offers.items():
            if oid in o['requests'] and o['service']==req['service'] and req['at']<=o['time']<leases[req['lease']]['end'] and int(o['network'].network_address)<=req['address']<=int(o['network'].broadcast_address):
                lst.append(oid)
        allowed[rid]=lst
    best=None;bestcost=None
    for choices in itertools.product(*[ [None]+allowed[r] for r in ids]):
        # quota counts
        rcount={};ocount={};ocap={}
        ok=True;cost=0;n=0
        for rid,oid in zip(ids,choices):
            if oid is None: continue
            n+=1;cost+=offers[oid]['cost']
            for p in rpaths[reqs[rid]['group']]:
                rcount[p]=rcount.get(p,0)+1
                if rcount[p]>rq[p]['capacity']:ok=False;break
            if not ok:break
            for p in opaths[offers[oid]['group']]:
                ocount[p]=ocount.get(p,0)+1
                if ocount[p]>oq[p]['capacity']:ok=False;break
            ocap[oid]=ocap.get(oid,0)+1
            if ocap[oid]>offers[oid]['capacity']:ok=False;break
        if not ok:continue
        if best is None or n>best or (n==best and cost<bestcost):
            best=n;bestcost=cost
    return best or 0,bestcost or 0,ids,allowed

for trial in range(300):
    R=random.randrange(0,6);O=random.randrange(0,5)
    job=make_job(R,O)
    active={f'r{i}':random.random()<0.7 for i in range(R)}
    exp_n,exp_c,ids,allowed=brute(job,active)
    ctx=validate(job)
    got=solve(ctx,active)
    if got['resolved']!=exp_n or got['cost']!=exp_c:
        print('MISMATCH trial',trial,'exp',exp_n,exp_c,'got',got['resolved'],got['cost'])
        print(json.dumps(job,indent=1));print('active',active)
        sys.exit(1)
    # validate assignments structure and constraints
    seen=set()
    rcount={};ocount={};ocap={};cost=0
    for a in got['assignments']:
        rid=a['request'];oid=a['offer']
        assert rid in ids and oid in allowed[rid] and rid not in seen
        seen.add(rid)
        req=ctx['requests'][rid];off=ctx['offers'][oid]
        assert off['service']==req['service']
        assert req['at']<=off['time']<leases[req['lease']]['end']
        assert int(off['network'].network_address)<=req['address']<=int(off['network'].broadcast_address)
        for p in ctx['request_paths'][req['group']]:
            rcount[p]=rcount.get(p,0)+1
            assert rcount[p]<=ctx['request_quotas'][p]['capacity']
        for p in ctx['offer_paths'][off['group']]:
            ocount[p]=ocount.get(p,0)+1
            assert ocount[p]<=ctx['offer_quotas'][p]['capacity']
        ocap[oid]=ocap.get(oid,0)+1
        assert ocap[oid]<=off['capacity']
        cost+=off['cost']
        kind=ctx['services'][req['service']]
        if kind=='tcp':
            assert a['send']==[] and a['finish']==[]
        elif kind=='adb':
            send=base64.b64decode(a['send'][0]);fin=base64.b64decode(a['finish'][0])
            sig=read_adb_response(send);assert sig[0]=='CNXN'
            sig2=read_adb_response(fin);assert sig2[0]=='AUTH' or True
            # CLSE unsupported by read_adb_response, check manually
            cmd,arg0,arg1,ln,chk,mag=struct.unpack('<6I',fin[:24]);assert cmd==0x45534c43 and arg0==0 and arg1==0 and ln==0 and chk==0 and mag==cmd^0xffffffff
        else:
            for frame in a['send']:
                body=base64.b64decode(frame)
                # parse length
                n=int.from_bytes(body[:4],'big');d=plistlib.loads(body[4:4+n]);assert d['Key'] in ('ProductVersion','ProductName') and d['Label']=='usbmuxd' and d['ProtocolVersion']=='2' and d['Request']=='GetValue' and len(body)==4+n
            assert a['finish']==[]
    assert got['cost']==cost
print('planning random tests OK')
